tools.name: healthCheck
tools.description: Check H-ear API health and liveness. No authentication required. Returns `{ apiStatus, apiVersion, apiDeployedTimestamp, mcpClientVersion }` — the `api*` fields come from `/v1/health`; `mcpClientVersion` is the version of the locally-installed `@h-ear/mcp-server` package the host pulled (read from its `package.json` at process start), used to verify `--pull` loaded the expected dist-tag.

tools.name: listClasses
tools.description: List supported audio classification classes. Default taxonomy: audioset-yamnet-521 (521 classes across 7 categories). Also available: audioset-panns-527 (527 classes), species (6522 bird species). Each class has a tierDepth (1–5) indicating its position in the AudioSet hierarchy, but filtering in getJobEvents and webhook notifications is supported up to tier 3 only. Response fields: total and totalFiltered both reflect the post-filter count; totalAvailable is the unfiltered class count for the entire taxonomy. Some AudioSet indices are retired and absent (e.g. 79, 83, 87) — this is normal, do not treat index gaps as errors. No authentication required.

taxonomy.description: Taxonomy to query. Defaults to audioset-yamnet-521.

category.description: Filter by category name (case-insensitive partial match). E.g. "Animal", "Human sounds", "Music".

tools.name: classifyAudio
tools.description: Classify a local audio file or public URL for noise/sound detection. Provide filePath (stdio + local FS) OR url (any transport — server marshals bytes via Azure Storage appendBlockFromURL, no client IO). With url, pass fileName so the job persists a display name in the UI; otherwise it defaults to "api-upload". Formats: MP3, WAV, FLAC, OGG, M4A, AAC, MP4, MOV, WEBM. Files over 25MB on filePath auto-split into 25 MB byte slices client-side; url has no client chunking. Returns { requestId, status } — poll getJob(requestId) until status='completed'. filePath returns 'uploading' while bytes arrive; url returns 'processing' immediately. Both transition to 'completed'. Requires API key (HEAR_API_KEY).

filePath.description: Path to a local audio file (Desktop/CLI only — requires local filesystem access). The server reads and encodes it automatically. Large files are split into chunks. Use url for web/mobile clients.

url.description: Public URL (or SAS URL) to an audio file. The server fetches bytes server-side via Azure Storage `appendBlockFromURL` (URL-marshal) — no bytes pass through the API host or the MCP client. Use this from web/mobile/sandboxed clients with no filesystem; also valid from stdio.

fileName.description: **When using `url`, pass `fileName`** (URL basename, e.g. "morning-0400.mp3") so the snippet/job persists a meaningful name in the UI. Otherwise it defaults to "api-upload.mp3". With `filePath`, it is auto-derived from the basename and may be omitted.

threshold.description: Confidence threshold (0.0-1.0). Only classes above this score are returned.

filterMinDurationSeconds.description: Minimum event duration filter in seconds.

waitForResult.description: If true, polls until classification completes (up to 30s — strict cap to stay within the MCP tool wall budget). On timeout returns the AsyncAccepted shape ({requestId, status:"processing", pollUrl}); call getJob(requestId) externally to keep watching. For jobs likely to take longer than 30s, use callbackUrl for webhook delivery instead. Default false — returns immediately with requestId.

callbackUrl.description: Webhook URL (HTTPS) for async result delivery. When provided, the server POSTs classification results to this URL on completion — no polling needed. Use getJob to check status manually.

callbackSecret.description: HMAC-SHA256 secret for webhook signature verification. Only used with callbackUrl.

latitude.description: GPS latitude (decimal degrees, -90 to 90). Tag the recording location. Must be paired with longitude.

longitude.description: GPS longitude (decimal degrees, -180 to 180). Tag the recording location. Must be paired with latitude.

tools.name: classifyBatch
tools.description: Classify multiple audio files. Provide filePaths (local files, recommended) or files (URL entries). For URL entries, pass each file's basename in fileName so jobs persist meaningful names; otherwise they default to "api-upload.mp3". Local files: submits all then polls each sequentially (may take minutes), or pass callbackUrl to skip polling and deliver results via webhook. URL files: returns immediately with batch ID (results via webhook). Max 50 files. Requires API key (HEAR_API_KEY).

filePaths.description: Array of local audio file paths to classify (Desktop/CLI only — requires local filesystem access). Use files with URLs for web/mobile clients.

fileName.description: **Pass `fileName`** (URL basename, e.g. "morning-0400.mp3") so the snippet/job persists a meaningful name in the UI. Otherwise it defaults to "api-upload.mp3".

files.description: Array of public audio URLs (alternative to filePaths). Requires callbackUrl.

callbackUrl.description: Webhook URL (HTTPS) for async result delivery. Required for URL-based files. Optional for local files — when provided, skips polling and delivers results via webhook instead.

callbackSecret.description: HMAC-SHA256 secret for webhook signature verification.

filterMinDurationSeconds.description: Minimum event duration filter in seconds.

latitude.description: GPS latitude (decimal degrees, -90 to 90). Applied to all files in the batch. Must be paired with longitude.

longitude.description: GPS longitude (decimal degrees, -180 to 180). Applied to all files in the batch. Must be paired with latitude.

tools.name: usage
tools.description: Get H-ear API usage statistics. Returns `{ tier, daily:{used,limit,remaining}, period:{minutesUsed,minutesLimit}, activeKeys? }`. **What counts toward `daily.used`:** every authenticated `/v1/*` call increments it — `listJobs`, `getJob`, `getJobEvents`, `getJobAudio`, `getJobWaveform`, `getJobReport`, `classifyAudio`, `classifyBatch`, **and `usage` itself** (the call you just made to read this value is already in the count). **What does NOT count:** unauthenticated endpoints (`healthCheck`, `listClasses`) and webhook CRUD. `period.minutesUsed` is separate — billable ML compute minutes only. Requires API key (HEAR_API_KEY).

tools.name: listJobs
tools.description: List recent classification jobs with status, file name, event count, and timestamps. Supports pagination. Requires API key (HEAR_API_KEY).

startDate.description: ISO8601 date range start — jobs created on or after this date (e.g. "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z").

endDate.description: ISO8601 date range end — jobs created on or before this date (e.g. "2026-04-04T23:59:59Z").

tools.name: getJob
tools.description: Get job metadata for a classification job: status, fileName, duration, eventCount, modelId, reportUrl, location, timestamps. Per-event records are NOT returned — `eventCount` is the total; call `getJobEvents(jobId)` for the per-event records (served as a SAS-URL envelope per ARCH-015). Requires API key (HEAR_API_KEY).

jobId.description: The job ID returned from classifyAudio or classifyBatch.

tools.name: getJobEvents
tools.description: Get noise events for a completed job — 100 per page, timeline order, no sort. Walk with `offset`; hasMore=false is the last page. Filters (category, tier2, tier3, minConfidence, startTime, endTime, sourceId, taxonomy) apply server-side. matchedTotal is exact when matchedTotalExact=true; otherwise it is a lower bound until hasMore=false. Tier filters (category/tier2/tier3) are exact from page 0 (denormalised summary); other filters become exact on the final page. summary.totalEvents is the unfiltered job total. downloadUrl is a SAS URL to the full events.json blob for SDK one-shot fetch — sandboxed callers (claude.ai connector, web HTTPS MCP) ignore it and walk pages instead. Time window is inclusive overlap, not strict containment. API key required.

jobId.description: Job ID from classifyAudio, classifyBatch, or listJobs.

offset.description: Pagination offset. Each call returns up to 100 events; pass offset=100 for the next page, etc. Walk until hasMore is false.

taxonomy.description: Filter by taxonomy: audioset-yamnet-521, audioset-panns-527, or species.

minConfidence.description: Minimum confidence threshold (0.0–1.0). e.g. 0.7 returns only events ≥70% confidence.

tier2.description: Filter by tier2 subcategory (e.g. "Domestic animals, pets", "Wild animals"). Narrows within a tier1 category.

tier3.description: Filter by tier3 class (e.g. "Dog", "Cat", "Bird"). Finest supported filter depth — tiers 4-5 exist in the taxonomy but are not filterable.

startTime.description: Only return events overlapping at or after this time in seconds (window is inclusive overlap, not strict containment).

endTime.description: Only return events overlapping at or before this time in seconds (window is inclusive overlap, not strict containment).

sourceId.description: Filter by noise source cluster ID.

tools.name: getJobAudio
tools.description: Get a time-limited SAS URL for streaming the source audio of a classification job. Returns a 1-hour URL for direct audio playback via HTML5 <audio> element or fetch. The URL supports HTTP Range requests — browsers can seek without downloading the full file. For event-specific playback, append a Media Fragment time range to the URL: audioUrl + "#t=1.92,5.76". Returns 200 + audioUrl for both file-uploaded and URL-submitted jobs (URL submissions persist an AppendBlob via appendBlockFromURL). 404 only fires for legacy URL jobs that pre-date URL-marshal. Requires API key.

jobId.description: Job ID from classifyAudio, classifyBatch, or listJobs.

tools.name: getJobWaveform
tools.description: Get pre-computed waveform data and audio URL for a completed classification job. Returns waveformUrl (peaks.js-compatible .dat binary) and audioUrl for synchronized playback. Initialize peaks.js with: Peaks.init({ dataUri: { arraybuffer: waveformUrl }, mediaElement: audioEl }). If waveformUrl is null, use wavesurfer.js with audioUrl instead (decodes via Web Audio API). Zoom controls resolution: 256=high detail, 1024=standard (default), 4096=overview. Both URLs expire in 1 hour. For event navigation, combine with getJobEvents to get startTime values for seeking. Requires API key.

jobId.description: Job ID from classifyAudio, classifyBatch, or listJobs.

tools.name: getJobReport
tools.description: Get a 7-day SAS URL to download the Excel analysis report for a completed classification job. Returns `{ jobId, reportUrl, expiresIn }`. Returns 409 if the job is still processing, 404 if the report blob is missing. Requires API key.

jobId.description: Job ID from classifyAudio, classifyBatch, or listJobs.

tools.name: createWebhook
tools.description: Create an enterprise webhook registration for async event delivery (job.completed, job.failed, etc.). Returns webhook details and a signing secret shown ONCE — save it immediately. Supports taxonomy and tier-based notification filtering. Requires API key or Bearer token (enterprise subscription).

url.description: HTTPS webhook URL where events will be POSTed.

events.description: Event types to subscribe to (e.g. job.completed, job.failed). Defaults to all events if omitted.

taxonomyFilter.description: Scope notifications to specific taxonomies (e.g. audioset-yamnet-521, species).

notificationTierDepth.description: AudioSet tier depth for filtering: 1=coarse (Animal), 2=mid (Domestic animals, pets), 3=fine (Dog). Max depth is 3 — the taxonomy has tiers 4-5 but webhook filtering does not extend beyond tier 3. Must pair with notificationTierValues.

notificationTierValues.description: Tier labels to match at the specified depth (e.g. ["Animal", "Music"]). Must pair with notificationTierDepth.

tools.name: listWebhooks
tools.description: List all enterprise webhook registrations. Shows URL, subscribed events, status, failure count, and notification filter config. Requires API key or Bearer token (enterprise subscription).

tools.name: getWebhook
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific enterprise webhook, including delivery stats, notification filters, and status. Requires API key or Bearer token (enterprise subscription).

tools.name: updateWebhook
tools.description: Update an enterprise webhook registration. Change events, URL, status (active/paused), or notification filters. Set status to "paused" to temporarily disable without deleting. Requires API key or Bearer token (enterprise subscription).

events.description: New event types to subscribe to.

status.description: Set to "paused" to disable or "active" to re-enable.

taxonomyFilter.description: Scope to taxonomies. Pass null to clear filter.

notificationTierDepth.description: AudioSet tier depth (1=coarse, 2=mid, 3=fine). Max depth is 3 — tiers 4-5 exist in the taxonomy but are not supported for webhook filtering. Pass null to clear. Must pair with notificationTierValues.

notificationTierValues.description: Tier labels to match. Pass null to clear. Must pair with notificationTierDepth.

tools.name: deleteWebhook
tools.description: Permanently delete an enterprise webhook registration. This action cannot be undone. Requires API key or Bearer token (enterprise subscription).

tools.name: pingWebhook
tools.description: Send a test ping event to an enterprise webhook to verify connectivity. Returns delivery result with response status and timing. Requires API key or Bearer token (enterprise subscription).

tools.name: listWebhookDeliveries
tools.description: List recent delivery attempts for an enterprise webhook. Shows event type, HTTP response status, success/failure, timing, and attempt count for audit trail. Requires API key or Bearer token (enterprise subscription).

webhookId.description: The webhook ID to get deliveries for.

tools.name: getUploadStatus
tools.description: Diagnostic endpoint — returns fine-grained slice-level upload progress for a chunked upload (fileName, totalSlices, slicesUploaded, totalBytes, requestId). Not required for the happy path: classifyAudio returns requestId on the FIRST chunk response, and getJob(requestId) reflects the upload → processing → completed lifecycle. State lives in the MCP server process — if the process restarted since the upload started, the session will not be found.

uploadSessionId.description: The uploadSessionId returned by classifyAudio for large files.
